Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner stated that the second phase of the Second Anglo-Afghan War was “(1880 onward),” which is inaccurate; the second phase began in September 1879 after the Kabul residency massacre. While this did not affect identifying the correct “what” (the Treaty of Gandamak) that ended the first phase, it is the first factual error in the conversation.
